welcome.title: Welcome to Balanced Health
welcome.subtitle: Short, trusted health info for employees. Not medical advice.
onboard.what.title: What this app does
onboard.what.body: Type a lab test and a number. We show short videos and easy articles that explain the result.
onboard.privacy.title: Privacy
onboard.privacy.body: Your numbers stay on your device. We do not save them.
onboard.how.title: How to use
onboard.how.body: Enter a test name (example: Vitamin D), type the number, then tap 'See resources.'
lab.hint.value: enter the number from your lab report (optional)
lab.privacyNote: You chose to enter this. It is not saved.
results.title: Learning resources
results.subtitle: These are educational—talk to your doctor for medical advice.
results.empty: No matches found. Try a different test name or number.
faq.isThisMedical.title: Is this medical advice?
faq.isThisMedical.answer: No. This is learning material only.
faq.doYouSave.title: Do you save my numbers?
faq.doYouSave.answer: No. Your numbers stay on your device unless you choose to save them.
faq.whoChecks.title: Who checks the videos?
faq.whoChecks.answer: Experts review everything before it’s shown.
